<style>:root{--bg: #000;--bg-2: #070d09;--card: #0b120d;--line: rgba(255,255,255,.55);--line-soft: rgba(255,255,255,.14);--text: #fff;--muted: #9a9a9a;--accent: #5fd98b;--accent-2: antialiased;overflow-x: hidden}img{max-width: 100%;height: auto;display: block}a{color: inherit;text-decoration: none}button{font: inherit;cursor: pointer;border: 0;background: none;color: 24px}.container--narrow{max-width: 860px}.center{display: flex;justify-content: center;margin-top: 48px}.btn{display: inline-flex;align-items: center;justify-content: center;gap: 10px;padding: 18px translateY(-2px);box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #0d4a25,0 18px 50px rgba(95,217,139,.35)}.btn--accent:active{transform: translateY(4px);box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #0d4a25,0 8px 20px rgba(95,217,139,.2)}.btn--ghost{border: 1px solid var(--line);color: #fff}.btn--ghost:hover{border-color: var(--accent);color: var(--accent)}.btn--xl{padding: 26px 64px;font-size: 19px}.btn--block{width: 100%}.section{padding: 64px 0;position: relative}.section--line::before{content: "";position: absolute;top: 0;left: 50%;transform: translateX(-50%);width: min(1072px,calc(100% - 48px));height: 1px;background: var(--line-soft)}.sec-head{display: flex;justify-content: space-between;align-items: center;gap: 24px;padding: 0 0 26px;border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom: 22px}.sec-head__title{color: var(--accent);font-size: clamp(24px,2.6vw,30px);font-weight: 700;letter-spacing: .01em}.sec-head__aside{color: #ddd;font-size: 17px;text-align: 900px;margin: 0 auto}.title-sub{text-align: center;color: #ddd;margin: 16px auto 0;max-width: 640px}.form{display: grid;gap: 14px}.field span{display: block;font-size: 13px;color: #aaa;margin-bottom: 6px}.field input{width: 100%;padding: 16px 18px;font: inherit;font-size: 16px;color: #fff;background: #060c08;border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius: 10px;transition: border-color .2s}.field input:focus{outline: none;border-color: var(--accent)}.field input.invalid{border-color: #e2584f}.form .btn{margin-top: 8px}.form__msg{font-size: 14px;min-height: 20px}.form__msg.ok{color: #7bd88f}.form__msg.err{color: #ff8a80}.contact{margin-top: 56px;display: flex;justify-content: space-between;align-items: center;gap: 24px;border: 1px solid var(--line);border-radius: var(--radius);padding: 28px 32px}.contact h3{font-size: 24px}.contact p{color: var(--accent)}.footer{border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft);padding: 40px 0 120px;color: #8a8a8a;font-size: 13px}.footer__top{display: flex;justify-content: space-between;gap: 16px;color: #ccc;font-size: 14px;margin-bottom: 18px;flex-wrap: wrap}.footer__top a:hover{color: var(--accent)}.footer__req{margin-bottom: 14px;line-height: 1.6}.footer__legal{font-size: 12px;color: #666}.contact{margin-top: 0}.step-label{display: inline-block;color: var(--accent);font-size: 13px;font-weight: 700;letter-spacing: .12em;text-transform: uppercase;margin-bottom: 12px}#usullar .step-label{display: block;text-align: center}.pay-hero{position: relative;overflow: hidden;padding: 72px 0 80px;background: radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 70% at 78% 50%,rgba(31,122,60,.38),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 60% at 50% 0%,rgba(40,110,65,.3),transparent h2{font-size: 24px;line-height: 1.2;margin: 6px 0 8px}.order p{color: #bbb;font-size: 14.5px;margin-bottom: 16px}.order dl{display: grid;gap: 8px;border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft);padding-top: 14px}.order dl div{display: flex;justify-content: space-between;gap: 12px;font-size: 15px}.order dt{color: #aaa}.order dd{font-weight: 700}.steps{list-style: none;display: grid;grid-template-columns: repeat(4,1fr);gap: 20px;margin-top: 48px}.method{display: flex;flex-direction: column;align-items: center;gap: 14px;text-align: center;background: #fff;color: #0b120d;border-radius: rgba(0,0,0,.15)}.method__icon--paynet{background-image: url(data:image/webp;base64,)}.method__icon--payme{background-image: url(data:image/webp;base64,)}</style>
